name: Your Place In The World
summary: Kaltunk sends new recruits in the Valley of Trials to Gornek for training. There, young orcs and Darkspear trolls begin their service to the Horde and learn what honor and survival demand in Durotar.

sections.title: Coming of Age in Durotar
sections.body: Young orcs and Darkspear trolls prove their worth in Durotar's arid Valley of Trials before they enter the wider world. Under Warchief Thrall, life demands strength, vigilance, and discipline. Kaltunk tests each eager recruit and turns their dreams of wrestling demons and dragons toward the practical duties ahead. In the canyon, training begins with humility before glory.

sections.title: Reporting to Gornek
sections.body: Gornek waits beside the camp fire, only steps from Kaltunk. The gruff veteran regards fresh arrivals with a skeptical eye and grumbles about the meager stock reaching camp. He hardens young fighters through trials, beginning with the vermin that threaten the encampment's supplies.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what is your place in the world
faq.answer: This rite marks a young recruit's entry into Horde service in the Valley of Trials. You go straight to Gornek, who begins your basic combat training and assigns your first duties.
Kaltunk is an orc overseer at the Valley of Trials entrance. He evaluates recruits coming of age and directs them to the proper trainers and leaders in camp.
Gornek is an experienced Horde trainer seated near the campfire in the Valley of Trials. He tests incoming recruits and hardens them into capable soldiers before they leave the canyon.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
aliases: next after your place in the world
faq.answer: Reporting to Gornek leads straight to the trial called 'Cutting Teeth'. Recruits head into the dirt to cull mottled boars and prove their basic martial skill.

faq.q: Why are recruits kept in the Valley of Trials?
faq.answer: The Valley of Trials is a secluded, protected canyon in Durotar. Recruits train, face evaluation, and are weeded out there before meeting the territory's deadlier beasts, quilboar, and enemy scouts.

faq.q: Does this quest differ between orcs and trolls?
faq.answer: Young orcs and Darkspear trolls begin training together in the Valley of Trials. Kaltunk gives them the same call to arms.

angles.text: Every young Horde recruit in Durotar must prove their grit in defense of their fledgling nation before taking up arms in the Warchief's name.
As an orc, coming of age and reporting for duty in the Valley of Trials marks a cultural milestone. It centers on personal honor and readiness for battle.
As a Darkspear troll, you settled in Durotar alongside your orc allies. Here, you train with your brethren to forge unity and survive together.
